title: Query addresses
description: The orders table has been pre-loaded with 10 records. Add street, city, state, zip_code columns. Then use a CTE with address data to populate: order 3 gets '123 Main Street, Springfield , CA, 12345', order 4 gets '234 Elm Avenue, lexington, ky, 23456', and so on for orders 6-10. Note the inconsistent formatting (extra spaces, mixed case, zip+4).
hints: ALTER TABLE to add all four address columns
UPDATE orders FROM address_data to populate the new columns
